questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of creative writing as described in the chapter?

options.text: To strictly follow rules and facts like in academic writing
To express personal feelings and imagination through words
To write reports and essays for school assignments
To copy famous authors’ styles and storiesCorrect Answer:B) To express personal feelings and imagination through words

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT listed as a form of creative writing in the chapter?
What is one suggested way to overcome writer’s block according to the chapter?

options.text: Stop writing forever and give up on creativity
Use a writing prompt to spark new ideas
Only write when you feel completely inspired
Copy someone else’s work to get startedCorrect Answer:B) Use a writing prompt to spark new ideas
